claim: OD-TBD filed 2026-10-08 from fix/orders-send-blank-followups (PR #672 pr-audits; ADR 0255 addendum of 2026-10-08): requestDraftSend, processScheduledAutoSends and issueManualReplySeal each compare the vendor's providers.restaurant_id with the house (refusing another house's vendor and an orphan, ADR 0221) before they act on the vendor they read: requestDraftSend the waiting draft's vendor, else the order's; the sweep and issueManualReplySeal the order's. In requestDraftSend the comparison is either inside its refuseBlanks closure or on both the waiting-draft and the no-draft path; issueManualReplySeal may do it in manualReplyTarget. OPEN — today none of the three compares it: requestDraftSend counts the first name resolved from that vendor as the fill for a greeting blank in its blank check, names that vendor to the managers and, with no draft, inserts a row with the order's provider_id; the sweep's send rewrites a leading greeting to the resolved first name and mails that vendor's address; issueManualReplySeal seals that vendor's address. issueDraftSendSeal and approveDraft compare it and refuse a mismatch; getPendingDraft compares it and reads a mismatch as no vendor; manualReply and confirmDeal compare it only when it is not null. Other routes of the same class known so far are listed in the OD row, not tracked here; that list is partial, and a full census of vendor-house checks is owed and not done. The verify reads code with // and /* */ comments removed and accepts either operand order. Known limits: a comparison inside a string literal would read as holding, and a real comparison written through an alias variable would still read as open, and a comparison of the house with the order's house (restaurantId !== order.restaurant_id) instead of the vendor's would read as holding.
